title: Arkret MLS Governance Read
description: Role-separated MLS governance reads. Self clients consume a bounded authenticated Account Station binding result; peer servers independently verify the near-current proof query/outcome. The self result never requires a replay checkpoint or delivers a history proof.

proposed_group_genesis_binding.description: Caller-proposed immutable Genesis binding, required only for the unique pre-Genesis 0 -> 0 branch. It enters the canonical query digest and cache identity and selects every-and-only frontier cells. It is not accepted authority; Genesis admission later requires the signed Genesis binding to match it exactly.

actor_id.description: Full accepted membership ActorId. Same signing principal at different Stations identifies distinct leaves and authorization; never infer Station from a current local session.

proof_request_common.description: The exact RFC 8785 canonical request must not exceed 8 MiB. This aggregate bound includes local_mls_leaves and is enforced after Schema validation and before materialization.

local_mls_leaves.description: Exact occupied public RFC 9420 leaves from the caller's locally verified current or pending group state, in strictly increasing leaf_index order. The service rejects duplicate leaf_index or credential_ref and proves governance state against this every-and-only set; the receiver repeats the comparison against its own group state. This is query input and is never copied into the response.

proof_base_basis.description: Exactly one confirmed head in the group enclosing Realm. Base is equal to or an ancestor of target; incomparable same-Realm heads are invalid.

proof_target_basis.description: Exactly one confirmed head in the group enclosing Realm. Base is equal to or an ancestor of target; incomparable same-Realm heads are invalid.

byte_limit.description: Caller-selected canonical response-byte ceiling for one complete near-current frontier selector. The response must fit without truncation or cursor. If the exact base-to-target frontier projection cannot fit, the caller must obtain a closer independently verified basis or fail closed; it cannot split cells or accept a partial frontier.

base_group_state_ref.description: Required only for a successor transition and byte-identical to the already accepted winning Genesis/Commit Event for previous_epoch. It never names the transition being authored. Genesis (0 -> 0) has no prior MLS group-state Event, so this field is forbidden there; this avoids an EventId/governance-binding authoring cycle.

proposed_group_genesis_binding.description: Present exactly for a pre-Genesis 0 -> 0 query with no accepted Genesis. Once an accepted Genesis exists, even a 0 -> 0 refresh forbids this field and derives the immutable binding from accepted state.

leaf_canonical_preimage_b64u.description: Unpadded base64url of the exact leaf_data bytes. For state_root this is RFC 8785 JCS UTF-8 of {cell,state:{revision_event_id,value}}. For control_event_set_root this is the full typed Event digest UTF-8 bytes, including its suite prefix.

leaf_digest.description: H(0x00 || decoded leaf_canonical_preimage_b64u) under the digest suite named by root_digest.

merkle_membership_witness.description: Closed RFC 6962 membership witness. The verifier resolves root_seal_ref, requires its signed root_field to equal root_digest, independently reconstructs the domain-specific canonical leaf bytes, requires leaf_index < leaf_count and consumes exactly the audit-path length implied by leaf_count. Siblings are ordered from the leaf level upward.

value_digest.description: Digest of the exact resolved cell value reconstructed from the content-addressed provenance Events; full value bytes are not embedded in the page.

provenance_event_refs.description: Canonical complete FSM/join-chain Event references. Their signed bytes are resolved outside the page and must match proof_material descriptors.

event_ids.description: Canonical every-and-only Event ids named by sparse frontier provenance entries and boundaries. Each id losslessly binds its suite-bearing full digest. This array is not a duplicate catalog of every Seal.delta Event in the base-to-target cut; those exact accepted Event selectors come from each resolved signed Seal.delta and are fetched separately for checkpoint replay.

seal_predecessor_edges.description: Canonical UTF-8 ordering by (seal_ref,predecessor_seal_ref). It contains every and only direct predecessor edge needed to verify the anchor-to-target closure, every activation cause and every predecessor root named by a first-coverage witness.

typed_proof_material.description: Complete every-and-only content-addressed selector set for one near-current stateless group_security_frontier response. seal_descriptors are canonical by seal_ref bytes, event_ids is the direct canonical EventId set, and predecessor edges are canonical by their tuple bytes; duplicates are forbidden. Sparse paths live only in typed witnesses. Full signed proof objects are resolved through standard Event/Seal resolve; each Event's recomputed digest must equal the suite and full digest losslessly encoded by event_id. Complete checkpoint replay additionally resolves the exact Event digest set signed in the resolved Seals' delta arrays; those Events are not duplicated into event_ids unless sparse provenance also names them.

frontier_range_witness.description: Included entries occupy every index in [start,end). Adjacent authenticated boundaries/state edges prove completeness, including an empty prefix.

state_root.description: The exact signed state_root of target_seal_ref. Every entry and boundary witness in this branch MUST use that same target Seal and root.

frontier_branch_projection.description: One independently signed target-branch projection. It never claims that a composite multi-Realm state root was signed by one Seal.

oneOf.description: Every-and-only frontier cells/ranges derived from the pinned registry and exact query, authenticated by quorum conclusions; no unsigned sparse subset or neighbor disclosure. Missing required ranges fail closed.

query_digest.description: SHA-256(UTF8('ak.mls-governance-proof-query-v1') || 0x00 || JCS(exact request)). The response does not repeat local_mls_leaves; the caller retains the request and requires this digest to match.

group_security_frontier_outcome.description: A deterministic, complete near-current response for the exact query_digest and its caller-retained group-binding selector and canonical base/target confirmed heads. Bulk history authorization and activation are reconstructed by direct accepted-Seal traversal and are not fields or profiles of this response.

self_read_request_body.description: Authenticated Account Station MLS binding query. At most 8 MiB canonical request bytes. The local leaf set remains end-to-end caller intent; the Station verifies governance at the exact basis.

local_mls_leaves.description: Exact occupied public RFC 9420 leaves from the caller's locally verified current or pending group state, in strictly increasing leaf_index order. The service rejects duplicate leaf_index or credential_ref and proves governance state against this every-and-only set; the receiver repeats the comparison against its own group state. This is query input and is never copied into the response.

seal_basis.description: Exactly one confirmed head in the group enclosing Realm. Base is equal to or an ancestor of target; incomparable same-Realm heads are invalid.

base_group_state_ref.description: Required only for a successor transition and byte-identical to the already accepted winning Genesis/Commit Event for previous_epoch. It never names the transition being authored. Genesis (0 -> 0) has no prior MLS group-state Event, so this field is forbidden there; this avoids an EventId/governance-binding authoring cycle.

proposed_group_genesis_binding.description: Present exactly for a pre-Genesis 0 -> 0 query with no accepted Genesis. Once an accepted Genesis exists, even a 0 -> 0 refresh forbids this field and derives the immutable binding from accepted state.

mls_epoch_head.description: Exact accepted registered ak.component.mls.epoch.v1 value at seal_basis, suitable for the caller-signed head_eq predicate. It is not merely a scalar epoch.

self_read_outcome.description: Complete authenticated Account Station result, at most 1 MiB canonical bytes; no Merkle witnesses, history closure, provenance catalog or continuation. The response does not repeat local_mls_leaves.

query_digest.description: SHA-256(UTF8("ak.mls-governance-frontier-query-v1") || 0x00 || JCS(exact self_read_request_body)); request binding, not a server authenticity proof.

epoch_head.description: Present exactly when the requested accepted basis has a winning epoch value; absence denotes no accepted epoch at that basis, never pending verification. A successor requires this head to match its base_group_state_ref and previous_epoch.

accepted_artifact_request_body.description: One exact already known MLS Genesis, Commit or Welcome artifact in a Realm/Circle. It asks the authenticated Account Station for current acceptance, not for a historical checkpoint. At most 64 KiB canonical request bytes.

accepted_leaf_authorization.description: Exact historical endpoint authorization for the same transition and frontier leaf_index. Device credentials require only device_authorize_event_id; Agent credentials require only agent_verification_method and agent_key_authorize_event_id; pairwise credentials forbid all authorization fields. No nulls, current-directory substitution or duplicated identity/key fields.

accepted_artifact_outcome.description: Complete bounded Account Station result: the exact artifact belongs to the current accepted winning MLS transition chain. It includes no history, Merkle witness or continuation. At most 16 MiB canonical response bytes, independently of the 64 KiB request limit.

mls_frontier_leaves.description: Exact durable post-transition public leaf input of transition_head.transition_ref, retained at admission. Never reconstructed from current directory order, transient claims or historical candidates.

mls_leaf_authorizations.description: Complete historical authorization association, strictly increasing by leaf_index and exactly matching mls_frontier_leaves indices and order. Missing authority is frontier_unavailable, never a partial result. Included in the existing 16 MiB response budget; excluded from shared frontier/removal digest preimages.

membership_removal_request_body.description: Current own-Station reconciliation against the complete accepted MLS ledger. Canonical request <=64 KiB; the caller supplies SHA-256(JCS(canonical sorted local leaves)) and the Station compares its independently reconstructed digest before returning indices. Realm/Circle only; no pending tree or continuation.

seal_basis.description: Exactly the one confirmed enclosing-Realm head used for this atomic accepted-ledger evaluation; must equal the request basis.

base_group_state_ref.description: Exact current winning accepted Genesis/Commit whose post-transition tree is the supplied local leaf set.

mls_leaf_set_digest.description: Canonical public leaf-set digest independently computed from the exact accepted base_group_state_ref ledger; never upload the leaf set again.

membership_removal_outcome.description: Complete sorted removal indices at the exact evaluated seal_basis, accepted base_group_state_ref and epoch; the server resolves its atomic accepted leaf ledger and compares the submitted digest before evaluation.

remove_leaf_indices.description: Strictly increasing subset of the exact requested occupied leaf indices. Empty only after complete successful evaluation; no Actor-wide removal.

seal_basis.description: Exactly the one confirmed enclosing-Realm head used for this atomic accepted-ledger evaluation; must equal the request basis.

base_group_state_ref.description: Exact current winning accepted Genesis/Commit whose post-transition tree is the supplied local leaf set.

frontier_registry_digest.description: sha256(RFC 8785 JCS bytes of the exact mls-security-frontier-registry.json artifact used for this projection). The verifier compares it with its locally pinned artifact digest; the service cannot select registry semantics.

branches.description: Canonical UTF-8 order by target_seal_ref and every-and-only the query proof_target_basis leaves.

merkle_frontier_projection.description: Per-target-leaf signed projections. The verifier checks the single target Realm head, exact quorum and proof cells before deriving security_frontier_digest. No merge of competing safety states is defined.
